name: fanout
description: Post one local video to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, X, Bluesky, Mastodon and PeerTube with your own self-hosted fanout, from Claude Code. The fanout server posts only after a preview of exactly that post, and the bundled skill asks for your approval before each one. Needs fanout installed (npm install -g --allow-git=all github:c10dev/fanout).
